title: Your AI agent's sandbox: it almost always has one, it's almost never on
excerpt: We saw it going through the documentation of the nine agents RosmarOps evaluates. And something came up that worries me more: turning it on isn't always enough.
seo_title: Sandbox in AI agents: who has one and who turns it on
seo_description: What a sandbox is, which AI agents ship with one and why almost all of them come with it turned off. What RosmarOps has started to show, with source and date.
alt: A small figure plays in a sandbox whose walls lie flat on the ground; the sand spills out towards some keys, some folders and a half-open door.
